note: Sierra NF campground on a wooded hillside above the west end of Bass Lake, run by a concessionaire; a few sites have limited lake views and others sit by the creek, with Road 222 between the campground and the lake. About half the paved spurs take a 23-ft rig (13 of 26 list an RV of 25-40 ft); none fit a boat trailer. Check in at the Bass Lake registration office first. --Claude
summary: Forks (Sierra NF, Bass Lake): FS page + rec.gov facility/rates/catalog + alerts + imagery. $52 confirmed (holiday +$2, extra vehicle $10); some first-come sites, 14-night max, 1-day cutoff, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums (FS); season May-September; 26 sites, 13 fit 23 ft+, max 40 ft; flush toilets + drinking water (stored vault toilets cleared). Lakeview confirmed. PIN ~1.75 km off - move.
